sources.title: DataForSEO API v3 documentation
claims: DataForSEO exposes a v3 REST API across 12 modules and ~200+ endpoints
Base production URL is https://api.dataforseo.com/v3

sources.title: DataForSEO pricing
claims: Pay-as-you-go pricing with a $50 minimum deposit, no seats
SERP Standard/Priority/Live priced per query

sources.title: Pricing Update in DataForSEO APIs
claims: DataForSEO cancelled monthly commitments and moved all endpoints to pay-as-you-go on 2026-07-01
The $100 monthly commitments for Backlinks API and LLM Mentions API were removed

The same update raised rates ~+20% across Backlinks, Business Data, Content Analysis, Labs, Domain Analytics, Keywords Data and OnPage, and +50% on Merchant Amazon Products/Sellers Task POST. Any cost figure observed on 2026-06-26 predates this increase.

sources.title: DataForSEO authentication
claims: HTTP Basic auth using base64(login:password); header-only, never URL parameters
API password is generated in the API Access tab and differs from the account password
No separate authentication call and no documented credential expiry (verified 2026-09-17)

sources.title: DataForSEO status & error codes
claims: 20000 Ok / 20100 Task Created; 40xxx client and 50xxx server codes
Rate limit is 2000 calls/min, 30 simultaneous, <=100 tasks/POST, 120s live timeout

The docs still describe 40204 as 'access denied ... activate your subscription' for Backlinks. This text is stale post-2026-07-01: a live backlinks/summary call on 2026-09-16 returned status_code 20000 on a pay-as-you-go account with no subscription.

sources.title: DataForSEO MCP server
claims: Official MCP server is published on npm as dataforseo-mcp-server; latest 3.1.1 (2026-08-25). The v3 redesign supersedes v2, which the repository marks deprecated.
Requires Node.js >=22 per package.json engines (was >=20 in the 2.9.x line).
Credentials are DATAFORSEO_LOGIN (DATAFORSEO_USERNAME accepted as an alias) and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD. ENABLED_MODULES is not documented in the v3 README; re-verify module gating before relying on it.

sources.title: DataForSEO official OpenAPI specification (all v3 endpoints)
claims: Machine-readable ground truth for DataForSEO v3: 453 endpoint paths across 12 modules (serp 128, keywords_data 56, dataforseo_labs 47, ai_optimization 46, business_data 40, on_page 29, app_data 29, merchant 25, backlinks 24, domain_analytics 14, content_analysis 11, appendix 4).

Contains 17 ai_optimization/llm_mentions paths, including the full v2 family (target_metrics, multi_target_metrics, top_mentioned_*, _lite variants, historical, timeseries_delta, timeseries_new_lost). These were previously recorded as undocumented; they are documented here.

Five llm_mentions v1 endpoints billable on the account are ABSENT from this spec: search/live, top_domains/live, top_pages/live, aggregated_metrics/live, cross_aggregated_metrics/live. Treat as legacy/undocumented-upstream, still billable.
Stored immutably at .raw/sources/dataforseo-openapi/ in the vault with PROVENANCE.json.

sources.title: DataForSEO GitHub organisation (full sweep, 15 repos)
claims: All 15 repos reviewed. Products: OpenApiDocumentation, mcp-server-typescript, Python/TypeScript/Java/CSharp clients, DataForSeoClientsGenerator, open-ai-actions, n8n-nodes-dataforseo, claude-skills, dataforseo-toolkit-skill, codex-plugins. langchain and langchainjs are forks, not products.

llm_mentions v1 retirement confirmed by three artifacts: OpenApiDocumentation (2026-09-09) omits v1; PythonClient (2026-09-11) exposes no callable v1 method, only orphaned model files; open-ai-actions (2026-09-03) documents v1 only and is stale.
A hosted MCP endpoint exists at https://mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp (type http), per codex-plugins .mcp.json.
The DataForSEO MCP returns an AI-optimized response that omits fields by default; noAiMode=true returns the full field set.
open-ai-actions paths carry a .ai suffix (ChatGPT Actions convention) and are not callable REST paths; do not use as endpoint ground truth.

sources.title: DataForSEO product updates / changelog
claims: Earliest-warning source for endpoint additions, deprecations and pricing changes. Leads both the OpenAPI spec and the account price table.
2026-09-16: Pinterest API and Social Media API support ENDED. 2026-09-15: Google Events SERP deprecated as a separate search engine type (Google retired the Events tab).

Recent additions: Google Trends Explore category-only filtering (no keyword required); Gemini LLM Responses direct_url field on Live and Task GET; new ETV calculation in Labs accounting for SERP features and intent; Google goto-link resolution across SERP elements incl. AI Overviews; ChatGPT ads rendered-status field; App Store subtitle support.

Drift direction is not consistent: Pinterest and Google Events were removed from the account price table while still present in the 2026-09-09 spec, whereas llm_mentions v1 was removed from the spec while still billable. Check all three sources - changelog, price table, spec - before concluding an endpoint's status.
